purpose: Canonical fixtures proving the six consumer-contract states (supported, missing-optional, stale, malformed, unsupported-version, partial-migration) for every Qor-logic-owned artifact type an external read-only consumer adapter might classify.
boundary: Qor-logic owns governance semantics and is the fixture producer; a downstream consumer owns presentation/enforcement and pins its adapter against these instead of hand-rolled local fixtures.

supported.note: current schema marker (qor:meta-ledger-schema=1), well-formed AUDIT/SEAL entries.

missing-optional.note: docs/META_LEDGER.md does not exist. No physical fixture file: the state IS the absent file. A consumer must classify this as unavailable, not malformed.

stale.note: well-formed, current schema marker, but latest entry timestamp predates as_of by over a year.

malformed.note: real AUDIT/SEAL content whose entry headings are corrupted, so the real parser silently returns zero records. Proves the false-negative a consumer must guard against.

unsupported-version.note: schema marker declares qor:meta-ledger-schema=2, one version ahead of this repository's current ledger_upgrade.SCHEMA_VERSION=1.

partial-migration.note: no schema-version marker at all (schema_version()==0, legacy pre-Phase-179 form) while still containing genuinely parseable prior entries.

supported.note: every row schema-valid; verified/unverified/n-with-rationale rows all present.

missing-optional.note: docs/FEATURE_INDEX.md does not exist. feature_index_verify.tally()/surface_lint() both already define this exact missing_index=True path; no physical fixture needed.

stale.note: FEATURE_INDEX carries no timestamp field anywhere in its schema or its markdown convention today. This repository defines no mechanism a consumer could pin a staleness fixture against without Qor-logic first adding one. Not fabricated.

malformed.note: one row with status n/a; the row-shape schema requires n_a_rationale when status is n/a, so building the schema-shaped envelope from this row fails validation.

unsupported-version.note: FEATURE_INDEX has no version marker analogous to meta-ledger's HTML-comment schema marker. This repository defines no such mechanism today. Not fabricated.

partial-migration.note: header declares the Surface column (Phase 138 / GH #196) but some rows carry a populated Surface cell (migrated) and others carry an empty one (legacy, pre-Phase-138 authoring) -- exactly what surface_lint()'s untagged-row detection already checks for.

supported.note: PASS verdict, all required fields, includes the Phase-67 optional target_content_hash.

missing-optional.note: no .qor/gates/<session_id>/audit.json for the session. validate_gate_artifact.validate_all_current_session() already defines the 'No gate artifacts for session' path; no physical fixture needed.

stale.note: schema-valid PASS artifact whose required ts field predates as_of by roughly seven months.

malformed.note: verdict VETO without findings_categories -- the schema's own allOf/if/then rule (Phase 37 / B20b) requires findings_categories whenever verdict is VETO.

unsupported-version.note: audit.schema.json carries no schema_version or comparable version field at all (confirmed by reading the schema before authoring this manifest). This repository defines no per-gate-artifact version marker today. Not fabricated.

partial-migration.note: two individually schema-valid artifacts: one omits the optional target_content_hash (pre-Phase-67 shape), one includes it (current shape) -- the exact phased rollout the schema's own field description documents. Two files, not one array, because a real .qor/gates/<sid>/ directory holds one JSON object per phase, never an array.

tracker-manifest.reason: The originating ask (issue text) names 'tracker manifest / programs.yaml' as a fourth Qor-logic artifact type, mirroring a downstream consumer's own readTrackerManifestArtifact() entry point. A repository-wide search of qor/, docs/, and gates/schema/ before authoring this manifest found no Qor-logic schema, parser, template, or producer for any 'tracker manifest' or 'programs.yaml' format. That format is defined and owned entirely by the consuming repository's own local roadmap/tracker tooling, not by Qor-logic. Publishing a 'canonical' Qor-logic fixture for a format Qor-logic does not define would fabricate authority this repository does not hold. Flagged on the originating issue for correction (drop this artifact type from the Qor-logic fixture-contract ask, or redirect it to whichever repository actually owns the format) rather than silently invented here.
